response.overview: In a secluded 18th-century village shaped by strict Catholic belief, outsider Luciel struggles to find her place within the world around her. When a mysterious winged being falls from the sky, she secretly shelters it and becomes determined to understand where it came from. As her search for answers draws her deeper into the religious beliefs she has always questioned, Luciel is forced to confront the boundaries between faith, certainty, and the unknown.
response.tagline: Question what you believe. Challenge what you know.
response.title: Valle
